name: LND
rootCause: In May 2025, LND.fi on the Sonic blockchain was drained of approximately $1.18 million after a trusted developer embedded a backdoor in the core lending contracts, expanding admin privileges to enable fund extraction. The exploit leveraged a malicious change in an access-control check, letting the Pool Admin directly transfer out user deposits. A developer with deployment privileges altered the 'onlyPool' access-control modifier in LND's AToken and VariableDebtToken contracts, allowing any address with the Pool Admin role,not only the protocol's own Pool contract,to execute fund-transfer functions.
